items.title: MoneyWeek Review of Billionaire Backlash
items.excerpt: "This book tells us a lot about how scandals can drive political change.... [it] usefully shines a light into a little studied area at the intersection between business and politics."

items.title: Billionaire Backlash and the Epstein Scandal -- Podcast with Andrew Keen
Kirkus Review of Billionaire Backlash
items.excerpt: "A smart set of case studies in support of greater corporate responsibility."

items.title: FT Review of Billionaire Backlash
items.excerpt: "It is a singular achievement of this well-timed, tightly written book that it ends on an optimistic note about democracy and ‘good populism’, when corporate-backed ‘bad populist’ autocracies seem to be in the ascendant."
